units.source_text: 两人正在看信，父亲惟光突然进来。

en.t: While the two were reading the letter, their father Koremitsu suddenly came in.

units.source_text: 两人吃了一惊，想把信隐藏，已经来不及了。

en.t: The two were startled and tried to hide the letter, but it was already too late.
Then he picked up the letter and read it.

units.source_text: 父亲看了信骂道：“你们干得好事！”

en.t: After reading the letter, their father scolded them, "What a fine thing you have done!"

units.source_text: 哥哥连忙逃走，父亲喊住了他，又问：“这信是谁写来的？”

en.t: The older brother hurriedly tried to run away, but his father called him back and asked again, "Who wrote this letter?"

units.source_text: 哥哥答道：“太政大臣家夕雾公子定要我送来……”

en.t: The older brother answered, "Young Lord Yugiri of the Chancellor's household insisted that I deliver it..."

units.source_text: 惟光听了这话，怒气尽释，笑逐颜开，说道：“公子已经懂得风情，真可爱啊！

en.t: When Koremitsu heard this, all his anger vanished; his face broke into a smile, and he said, "The young lord already understands affairs of the heart. How charming!

units.source_text: 你们与他同样年纪，还是毫不懂事的笨孩子呢。”

en.t: You are the same age as he is, yet you are still foolish children who understand nothing at all."

units.source_text: 他称赞了一会之后，便把信拿去给夫人看，对她说道：“像公子那样的人，倘能看得起我们这女孩而宠爱她，

en.t: After praising him for a while, he took the letter to show his wife and said to her, "If someone like the young lord were to think well of our girl and favor her,

units.source_text: 那么我与其叫她去当个寻常的宫女，还不如把她嫁与公子吧。

en.t: then rather than have her become an ordinary lady-in-waiting, I might as well marry her to him.

units.source_text: 我知道大臣的脾气：他一旦看中了一个人，便永远不忘记她，是很可靠的。

en.t: I know the Chancellor's nature: once he has taken a liking to someone, he never forgets her, so he is very dependable.
The young lord is surely just like his father.
Then I could become another Akashi Novice!"

units.source_text: 但别人都忙着准备舞姬入宫之事。

en.t: But everyone else was busy preparing for the dancer's entry into court.
